title: Yummy Smoky Greek Pork Pie
description: A malty, pillowy, comforting Greek pie featuring smoked ground pork and a creamy yogurt filling.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan and sauté diced onion until translucent.
Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Stir in ground pork, cooking until browned and crumbly.
Season the pork with smoked paprika, oregano, salt, and pepper, then mix thoroughly.
Allow the pork mixture to cool slightly while preparing the filling.
In a bowl, combine Greek yogurt, chopped dill, and crumbled feta cheese.
Arrange 6 phyllo sheets on a greased baking sheet, brushing each sheet with melted butter.
Spread half the pork mixture evenly over the phyllo layer, then spoon half the yogurt mixture on top.
Cover with the remaining 6 phyllo sheets, brushing each with melted butter and folding edges to seal.
Bake for 30 minutes until the pastry is golden and puffed.
Remove from oven, let rest 5 minutes, then cut into squares and serve warm.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
